layers.label: Street
layers.usage_policy: OSMF community tile servers run on donated capacity. Acceptable for development and low-volume use only. Heavy use, including distributing an application that fetches these tiles, is forbidden without prior permission. Before any public deployment, switch this layer to a self-hosted renderer or a commercial provider; only the url_template and attribution_text change.
layers.notes: Chosen as the default because it needs no credential, so a fresh checkout renders a map immediately.

layers.label: Satellite
layers.attribution_text: Imagery: U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map
layers.usage_policy: Public domain US Government work. Free with no restrictions; USGS requests acknowledgement of the originating agency, which attribution_text provides. Deliberately chosen over Esri World Imagery, which is visually similar but is NOT free for commercial use and requires an ArcGIS licence.
layers.notes: Note the {z}/{y}/{x} ordering: ArcGIS REST puts row before column, unlike the usual slippy-map {z}/{x}/{y}.

layers.label: Terrain
layers.attribution_text: Topographic base: U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map
layers.usage_policy: Public domain US Government work. Free with no restrictions.
layers.notes: USGS topographic rendering, including contours and relief. DUMBO's 23 m rise from the waterfront is legible here, which makes it a useful cross-check on the interpolated ground surface (DOQ-003).

layers.label: Hybrid
layers.attribution_text: Imagery and topography: U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map
layers.usage_policy: Public domain US Government work. Free with no restrictions.
layers.notes: Imagery with topographic linework and labels composited by the publisher, so no separate label overlay is required.

layers.label: Plain
layers.usage_policy: Renders no basemap tiles at all. Present so the district's own tile grid, fidelity zones and foreign-asset corridors can be read without imagery behind them, and so the map view works with no network access.

notes: Every layer here is credential-free by design, so the project renders on a fresh checkout with no signup. Commercial providers (Google Map Tiles, Bing Maps, Mapbox, MapTiler, Esri) are all supported by the same contract: add a layer with requires_credential true and a credential_hint naming the environment variable. Never put a key in this file. See digital-3d-shared-contracts/BASEMAP-LAYERS.md.
